text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Did Curren do a good job?
choice_data_list: You can do even better, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, next time I get 1st place,
you have to give me waaaay more praise than today, okay?!

"I'll definitely take 1st place in our next race, cutely...!
And so, I made that promise with Curren Chan."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Because the fastest, most amazing, and cutest one in the race... has to be Curren♪

As Curren Chan spoke, a sparkling... flame of determination
burned within her eyes.
